answer_1.quote: Applying pretrained generative models on these sequence labeling / structured predictions problems requires creating the input and target strings from the original input sentences and labels.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include labeled spans such as named entities or slots, represented in various formats like Tagged Spans, Sentinel+Tag, etc.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the different Seq2Seq formats, we primarily relied on two metrics: 1. Perfect: This reflects the % of times, an example is parsed perfectly i.e., all tagged spans are identified correctly with the right tag. 2. F1: Using CoNLL style evaluation of tagged spans, we report Micro F1 (Macro-F1 trends were consistent with Micro-F1 findings).
